title: On the Sparsity-Storage-Accuracy Tradeoff in Parsimoniously Activated Dictionary Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.22352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dictionary learning has long been studied from both optimization and probabilistic perspectives. While formulations with element-wise sparsity regularization (e.g., L1-based sparse coding) admit well-established probabilistic interpretations, many structured variants that impose global constraints lack a clear and tractable generative view. In this paper, we revisit a class of practically effective yet theoretically under-explored dictionary learning methods that impose a simple global regularization on the number of activated dictionary atoms, which we term parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (PADL). We show that PADL admits an equivalent formulation as maximum a posteriori estimation under a structured generative model, with auxiliary latent variables that govern global activation patterns. This formulation allows us to derive generalization guarantees that are difficult to obtain under the original formulation. More

translated_title: 论简约激活字典学习中的稀疏性-存储-精度权衡
translated_abstract: 字典学习长期以来一直从优化和概率两个视角进行研究。虽然带有逐元素稀疏正则化（例如基于L1的稀疏编码）的公式已有完善且成熟的概率解释，但许多施加全局约束的结构化变体却缺乏清晰且易于处理的生成式视角。在本文中，我们重新审视一类在实际中行之有效但在理论上尚欠探索的字典学习方法，这类方法对被激活的字典原子数量施加简单的全局正则化，我们将其称为简约激活字典学习（PADL）。我们证明PADL可以等价地表述为在一个结构化生成模型下的最大后验（MAP）估计，其中辅助潜变量控制全局激活模式。这一表述使我们能够推导出在原始表述下难以获得的泛化保证。
tldr: 本文为简约激活字典学习（PADL）提供了生成式概率解释，证明其等价于结构化生成模型下的最大后验估计，从而推导出原本难以获得的泛化保证，并刻画了稀疏性、存储与精度之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a generative probabilistic interpretation of parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (PADL), showing its equivalence to MAP estimation under a structured generative model, which enables generalization guarantees that characterize the sparsity-storage-accuracy tradeoff.
